valid procedures: Exact marginal endpoint gaps or simultaneous support-and-width set
invalid procedures: Parametric and empirical percentile; ordinary Wald
evidence: proved

regime: one endpoint truly known
valid procedures: Exact Beta pivot; endpoint basic m-out-of-n and subsampling pointwise
invalid procedures: Parametric and empirical percentile; empirical n-out-of-n distribution
evidence: proved

regime: endpoint and shape free
valid procedures: Exact exponential spacings F and chi-square; independent mixed-rate limits
invalid procedures: Endpoint percentile and joint Wald
evidence: proved

regime: one coefficient truly known
valid procedures: Exact exponential or gamma pivot
invalid procedures: Endpoint percentile and endpoint Wald
evidence: proved

regime: endpoint and shape free
valid procedures: Exact reflected log spacings F and chi-square; independent mixed-rate limits
invalid procedures: Endpoint percentile and joint Wald
evidence: proved

regime: one coefficient truly known
valid procedures: Exact exponential or gamma pivot
invalid procedures: Endpoint percentile and endpoint Wald
evidence: proved

regime: interior mode and both endpoints held
valid procedures: Exact binomial count inversion; model likelihood methods; null LR Monte Carlo
invalid procedures: Ordinary observed-Hessian inverse
evidence: proved

regime: boundary mode and both endpoints held
valid procedures: Exact binomial count inversion or null LR; PPP calibration pointwise
invalid procedures: Half chi-square cone calibration
evidence: numerical rejection of half chi-square; proved exact procedure and PPP limit

regime: known threshold and held xi in [-1 -1/2]
valid procedures: Exact maximum pivot; localized PPP LR below critical and mixed-rate Gaussian at critical
invalid procedures: Ordinary endpoint Wald; regular chi-square LR below critical
evidence: proved pivot and held-shape MLE laws; numerical coverage

regime: known threshold and known scale at free xi=-1
valid procedures: Null inversion; boundary MLE at -1 under the null
invalid procedures: Generic half-normal or half chi-square at this null
evidence: proved

regime: xi below -1 or unrestricted threshold path
valid procedures: No MLE interval on unbounded path; exact pivot for separate well-defined fixed-shape experiment
invalid procedures: Finite regular MLE inference
evidence: proved

regime: held negative xi and endpoint moves
valid procedures: Exact exponential-spacing pivot with scale nuisance; full-null projection
invalid procedures: Ordinary endpoint Wald at xi<=-1/2
evidence: proved pivot; numerical coverage

regime: xi=-1 held and both location and scale free
valid procedures: Exact shifted-exponential spacings; independent mixed-rate limits
invalid procedures: Ordinary joint Fisher Wald
evidence: proved

regime: free xi=1
valid procedures: Nuisance-aware cone LR under regular constrained localization
invalid procedures: Symmetric ordinary Wald for active shape
evidence: proved conditional

regime: held nu in (0 1/2] and free mean
valid procedures: Affine-null calibrated LR at fixed nu; fBm or critical Gaussian after localization
invalid procedures: Ordinary mean Wald and blanket percentile calibration
evidence: proved fixed-nu null procedure and local experiment; numerical LR checks below 1/2

regime: held nu in (0 1/2] and movable cusp
valid procedures: Affine-null LR for raw mode at fixed skew; full-null projection for mean or free skew; mixed rates in raw coordinates
invalid procedures: Ordinary joint Fisher Wald; attaching cusp rate to mean with free skew
evidence: proved local experiment and scope; numerical LR at fixed skew

regime: held nu and raw cusp fixed
valid procedures: Regular profile LR or model score with rank verification
invalid procedures: Ordinary location inference for held quantities
evidence: proved under regular likelihood conditions

regime: nu free at lower bound 1
valid procedures: Cone LR under regular localization; null simulation
invalid procedures: Ordinary symmetric Wald for active constraint; unrestricted bootstrap default
evidence: proved conditional

regime: lambda=1/2
valid procedures: Critical Gaussian mixed-rate LR under localization or full-null projection
invalid procedures: Joint ordinary Fisher Wald
evidence: proved local experiment; fit transfer open

regime: 1/2<lambda<1
valid procedures: PPP calibration under localization or full-null projection
invalid procedures: Joint Wald and ordinary endpoint LR
evidence: proved local experiment; fit transfer open

regime: lambda=1 or 2 held
valid procedures: Exact uniform inversion intersected with held constraints
invalid procedures: Formal score inverse and endpoint percentile
evidence: proved

regime: lambda=1 free on principal branch
valid procedures: Mixed PPP and restricted Gaussian with exact held geometry; full-null projection
invalid procedures: Joint chi-square or ordinary joint Gaussian cone
evidence: proved local experiment; fit transfer open

regime: lambda>1 held other than 2
valid procedures: Full-null projection with fixed-shape sampling; power rate n with positive edge density
invalid procedures: Ordinary Wald and generic chi-square endpoint LR
evidence: proved local experiment; fit transfer open

regime: lambda=-1 active and mu free
valid procedures: Cone LR under regular localized fit
invalid procedures: Unrestricted percentile or symmetric Wald as automatic default
evidence: proved conditional

regime: alpha=0 with xi and omega fitted
valid procedures: LR or score in centered signed cubed shape; invert monotone transform; affine null calibration
invalid procedures: Original-coordinate Wald; raw cubic basic bootstrap at symmetry
evidence: proved local chart and conditional limit; numerical Gaussian limit coverage

regime: alpha=0 with xi free and omega held
valid procedures: Use constrained squared chart after fitting the mean; full-null projection for signed shape
invalid procedures: Ordinary signed-shape Wald
evidence: proved leading chart; signed MLE transfer open

regime: alpha or xi truly held at symmetry
valid procedures: Regular inference for identified free subset
invalid procedures: Intervals for exact held values as if estimated
evidence: proved under regular likelihood conditions

regime: all-free diagonal size=beta
valid procedures: Cone LR in mean and squared gap; recover unordered roots; null simulation with nuisance protection
invalid procedures: Wald in labeled coordinates; unrestricted refit bootstrap for gap
evidence: proved regular quotient and conditional limit

regime: one member of symmetric pair held
valid procedures: Regular local inference if globally identified in that held submodel
invalid procedures: Quotient half-chi-square applied automatically to held chart
evidence: proved rank; global fit conditions apply

regime: known scale and shape2=1 with both other shapes free
valid procedures: Exact exponential product with shape2 held; conditional null test of shape2=1 when free; compact-index Gaussian supremum under localization
invalid procedures: Ordinary 3D Wald; fixed one-ray reference; identification of factors on null
evidence: proved pivot and compact local process; full localization open

regime: known scale and shape2=1 with one of shape1 or shape3 held
valid procedures: Regular local score or profile LR with rank check
invalid procedures: Applying free-ridge calibration to held chart
evidence: proved local rank

regime: named model escape or finite face
valid procedures: Separate prespecified face analysis or proved seam LR with nuisance profiling
invalid procedures: Intervals for diverging original coordinates; treating selected face as fixed design
evidence: proved for listed seams; selection validity open

regime: held boundary or degenerate support
valid procedures: Recompute actual held submodel and its rank; exact support inversion where available
invalid procedures: Automatic half chi-square or treating a sample-selected constraint as known
evidence: proved principle; family-specific coverage required

regime: interior mode and at least one endpoint free
valid procedures: Invariant interquartile rank and exact uniform extreme bands projected through Q_p; profile chi-square with mixed-rate global fits
invalid procedures: Ordinary joint root-n Wald or unaudited endpoint percentile
evidence: proved global localization and LR; numerical coverage for invariant box

regime: boundary mode with coincident endpoint fitted
valid procedures: Invariant rank box or calibrated wedge LR with both optima and exact hold constraints; opposite endpoint has chi-square LR
invalid procedures: Generic Gaussian cone for coincident endpoint or mode
evidence: proved global localization and wedge LR; numerical coverage for invariant box
source: infer2-math report Triangular and Finite-sample intervals

regime: boundary mode with coincident endpoint held and opposite endpoint fitted
valid procedures: Invariant rank box intersect holds or wedge with h=0 and independent critical block
invalid procedures: Generic half chi-square for mode
evidence: proved global localization and LR; numerical coverage for unrestricted invariant box

regime: boundary mode genuinely held and coincident endpoint free
valid procedures: This fit places the endpoint at the held mode a.s. at the boundary; invert candidate laws for valid inference across interior and boundary
invalid procedures: Zero-width interval as uniform procedure over nearby interior modes
evidence: proved deterministic boundary fit and valid invariant box
source: infer2-math report Triangular and Finite-sample intervals

evidence: proved global fit and LR; numerical invariant-box coverage

regime: free xi=-1 with location and scale held
valid procedures: Invariant rank intersect holds or candidate-specific null inversion; pointwise LR tends to zero
invalid procedures: Half-chi-square or exponential applied to this shape-only fit
evidence: proved degenerate limit

valid procedures: No MLE inference when the endpoint can contact the maximum; consult held-location exception
invalid procedures: Regular likelihood intervals for unbounded fit
evidence: proved divergence and prior held-location exception

evidence: proved mixed-rate global fit and LR in finite transition layer; numerical invariant-box coverage
